title: Huly header
description: Transparent dark header that floats over the hero: logo and wordmark, plain white links with dropdown chevrons, a star link and two small outline pills. On phones a two-line burger opens a full-width menu.
notes: dark by default (tone="dark" adds the dark class); use tone="inherit" on a light page
position="absolute" floats it over the next block; the chevrons are decoration, not dropdowns
name: huly-header

props.name: brand
props.description: wordmark next to the logo; also the home link's label

props.name: logo
props.description: logo mark (an svg or img) shown before the wordmark

props.name: star
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }
props.description: quiet link with an icon before the buttons (e.g. "Star us")

props.name: actions
props.description: small outline pills at the right end (e.g. log in, sign up)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: label of the phone menu button, for screen readers

props.name: tone
props.description: dark forces the dark colours (as on the original); inherit follows the page

props.name: position
props.description: absolute floats over the next block; sticky stays on screen
